question: Who is a famous Kuchipudi Dancer to receive Padma Shri in 2001?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sobha Naidu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sobha Naidu** was a renowned **Kuchipudi dancer** from India.
 
• She received the **Padma Shri** award in **2001** for her contributions to the art of Kuchipudi dance.
 
• She was known for her **graceful performances** and her efforts in **popularizing Kuchipudi** both in India and abroad.
 
• Sobha Naidu trained under the guidance of **Vempati Chinna Satyam**, a legendary Kuchipudi dancer and guru.
 
• She has also trained numerous students and contributed significantly to the field of **dance education**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Rekha Raju**__

 __
 
• **Rekha Raju** is a well-known **Bharatanatyam and Mohiniyattam dancer** from India.
 
• She has received several awards for her contributions to these dance forms.
 
 
 
• **Mukti Mohan**__
 __
 
• **Mukti Mohan** is an **Indian contemporary dancer** and actress.
 
• She is known for her participation in various dance reality shows.
 
 
 
• **Padmini**__
 
 
• **Padmini** was a famous **Indian actress and classical dancer**, known for her work in Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, and Hindi films.
 
• She was one of the renowned **“Travancore Sisters”** who were celebrated for their dance skills.
